thread:
alec_cs: Quick heads-up — I'm finalizing the QBR deck for NovaHealth (renewal in 3 weeks). Need a 30/60/90 token burn forecast and any spend anomalies to call out.
mira_csm: Got it. I ran the onboarding checklist yesterday; usage looks stable but large spikes on inference_test and batch-embeds.
kevin_finops: Sharing preliminary forecast: ```30d: 1.2M tokens
60d: 2.5M tokens
90d: 3.8M tokens
Committed: 3.0M tokens``` Expect ~15% over-commit in month 1 without optimization.
olivia_se: I can cut batch-embed batch_size to 16 and enable prefix caching for the FAQ route — should shave ~12% off tokens. Will test on staging by EOD.
billing-bot: ALERT: NovaHealth account crossed 80% of month-to-date committed tokens (threshold=80%).
alec_cs: Good — include the alert screenshot in the deck. Mira, can you capture customer reaction to the usage spike? Any recent enablement tickets?
mira_csm: Customer reported "slower than expected responses" last week — filed ticket #CS-492. Logged as config/regression. They also asked about cost controls and guardrails.
sam_prod_analytics: FYI I pulled model distro: 60% small-chat, 30% batch-embeds, 10% rerank. Most expensive op is rerank for search pipelines.
kevin_finops: If rerank is 10% of calls but 35% of token spend, recommend A/B moving rerank to lighter model during peak hours + fallback. Projected savings ~20%.
olivia_se: I'll prototype a canary routing rule: rerank -> rerank-lite between 10:00-18:00 PST with 30% traffic. Need approval for config change.
alec_cs: Approve the canary. Also add a slide with 'suggested guardrails' (quota alert thresholds, auto-scaling burst caps, recommended quantization).
mira_csm: I'll capture customer feedback bullets: value of latency improvements, acceptance of occasional quality tradeoff for cost, ask about dedicated predictability.
kevin_finops: Add a 'runway' slide: if consumption stays at current rate, they hit committed +15% in 27 days. If we apply optimizations, runway extends to 45 days.
alec_cs: Can someone draft a 1-slide action plan with owners and dates? Olivia for optimizations, Kevin for forecast numbers, Mira for customer comms. Target: draft by tomorrow 2pm.
olivia_se: On it — will post staging test results and token delta.
mira_csm: I'll schedule a pre-QBR dry run with AM + SE for Friday.
alec_cs: Thanks team. I'll assemble the deck and include the alert timeline and sample query that caused the spike.
kevin_finops: Uploading CSV of daily token usage to the QBR folder now: link: https://redwood.box/nova-qbr/usage.csv
mira_csm: Also adding customer quote re: "need better cost predictability" to the risks slide.
alec_cs: Perfect. :thumbsup:
